programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Grizzly Bears, Orcas, Elephants, Wolves, Olive Baboons In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Amazon. A magnificent broad-leafed rainforest. The heart of Brazil. The Amazon basin covers an impressive 7 million square kilometres. Rainforests are often known as the lungs of our planet. The Amazon Rainforest is the largest. Its value in terms of the Oxygen that it provides, and the Carbon Dioxide that it consumes is immeasurable. It is home to splendid, exquisite plant and animal species. The most diverse and numerous array of species found anywhere in the world.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Australia
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.
programme.sub-title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Whether by wing, fin or hoof, epic migrations are among nature's most awe-inspiring events. Animals undertake these arduous journeys, for many reasons: to find a mate, to give birth, or to move to new feeding grounds. And danger lurks at every turn. In this episode we discover the lengths they go to in order to survive.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Wild Madagascar - Fantastic Creatures
programme.desc: Madagascar is located roughly 250 miles from Africa's Southeast Coast. It is roughly the size of France, making it the world's fourth largest island. Isolated from the African mainland for over 160 million years, more than 250,000 different species of animal can be found here; 70% of which are found nowhere else on the planet. Madagascar supports the third largest coral reef system in the world; the Toliara reef system.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the savannah of southern Africa, rains have turned the land green and lush. It's the time of plenty and for the cast of wild characters here, cashing in is priority number one. From polecat to aardwolf, some of the continent's most seldom seen creatures are out to make the most of the abundance. Some families gorge on the plentiful grasses, while for others there's no such thing as an easy meal, even at this time of year.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Hunting has been a long-standing cultural tradition in the North Eastern India for long. But with the shirking of the forests and endangering of the wildlife, hunting has become unsustainable. But it is not that this has stopped hunting. The architects of Pakke, a 800 sq Kms forest reserve, in the heart of the hunting villages has done a wonderful job of giving protection to the several endemic species here by keeping the forest safe from the hunters.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Journey to the Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: March (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a subcontinent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Australia
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: April (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: aster, a time of babies, easter eggs are everywhere as birds get busy breeding, lambs dance around fields and cute baby bunnies emerge from their borrows. Migrants like ospreys and puffins return to their breeding sites. Migrants can come in all shapes and sizes and for different reasons. Hammerhead sharks swarm around Galapagos and take advantage of cleaning services on the reef.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Being a wild mum is one of the toughest jobs on earth. From the second a mother gives birth, everything changes. No longer footloose and fancy free, they find themselves completely responsible for tiny, delicate little lives - lives that would be helpless without them. For some, being a mother comes naturally, whilst for others it will take a little practoce. But while the responsibility is immense, being a mum is also incredible.

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of remarkable and awe-inspiring wildlife.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: May (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: While we celebrate may day, the coming of summer, there are many changes going on in the world. As snows finally melt in the mountains of Europe, chamois lambs have the chance to test out their climbing skills and explore their vertical home, watching all the time for eagles, their main predators. On the vast plains of the Russian the weird looking saiga antelope have their calves, while Florida enters its fire season and even the everglades can burn

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: Nature's Cutest
programme.desc: As we all know the natural world can be tough and challenging at times, but it can also be nothing short of adorable. Fluffy white seals, wobbly-kneed fawns, playing polar bear cubs, adorable teddy bear-like koalas - so much cute it would be impossible to decide which was the most adorable. But why do we consider some animals cute and others not? What it is about them that makes us fall in love? Perhaps it's those animals that remind us of ourselves?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at how the Soviet Union and the United States sponsored experiments in remote viewing during the Cold War. It also looks at how the CIA spent $20 million dollars investigating remote viewing as a part of Project Stargate. It also discusses how remote viewers were used to look for the Mars Observer and a possible Mars Base.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at how some world leaders throughout history have used impostors and doubles. It considers theories whether Osama bin Laden had a double, Elizabeth I died in her youth and was replaced by a boy, George Washington was replaced by the head of the Illuminati Adam Weishaupt, and that Hitler faked his suicide and fled to Argentina.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Certain structures on our planet have stood the test of time and continue to astonish mankind. So much so, that alien intervention in their construction thousands of years ago, has yet to be ruled out.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Some places in the world, record more UAP sightings than the rest. So many so, in fact, that people flock from all over the world just for the chance to glimpse a flying saucer.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: UAPs have only recently been witnessed entering the ocean at very high speeds. And since our oceans can be as much as six miles deep, is it possible that some of these UAPs were simply trying to get home?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: It is likely that aliens exist in a universe as large as ours. How would they navigate those vast distances and potentially visit us on earth?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent of late and been measured on ever more sophisticated technology. It has lead to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact across the globe, including by the US government. What could these visitors be after? Is it the potential energy stored in the Earth's oceans?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Several US presidents throughout history have described encounters with UAPs. Is there already an agreement in place between our world leaders and intelligent alien life? And if so, who is keeping that information from the public and why?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Everyday, UFOs are spotted in skies all over the world. But of all the planets in the known galaxy, why have they come to Earth? Are aliens here to seize Earth's riches? And how far does their mission go?

programme.title: UFO Casebook
programme.desc: Of all the various kinds of UFO related phenomenon that has materialized, the so called light spheres certainly hold a particularly important place. These objects have recently gained great popularity thanks in part to the studies conducted by Dr. Eltjo Haselhoff, who believes that these light spheres could be the cause behind crop circles. The lights began to appear many years ago...but why?

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: These attacks are the most terrifying part of the phenomenon, and therefore, the most real. Attacks in the middle of the morning, like what happened with Nicolás Sánchez Martín, in Cáceres, or Joan Turu and José Félix Rodríguez, better known as the suicide bombers of Tarrasa, can lead to the death of the witnesses. What is behind these aggressive apparitions?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Examining the possibility that UFOs may be from Earth.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: For decades, scientists have been searching for proof that extraterrestrials exist. But just where does alien life exist? And what does it look like? Join us as we investigate just how close we are to First Contact.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: A mysterious book, 'The Blue Planet Project' has surfaced, outlining decades of cooperation between the U.S. military and alien forces on earth as well as a massive government cover-up to hide these visitors from the world.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Aliens have been trying to make contact with mankind for millennia. Now for the first time, one of those messages has been decoded and we will share that message with the world.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Could one of the most sacred place on Earth also house secret knowledge of extraterrestrial life? The path to disclosure just might lie on holy ground: at the Vatican.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Tampered space photos, missing NASA recordings and a race to the moon all point to one very likely possibility: alien life exists, and our universe is anything but our own.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Since the dawn of man, unexplained illnesses have attacked the human population with a vengeance. Are these diseases the result of a secret alien agenda to take over Planet Earth? Tonight, we unseal the truth behind these Alien Plagues.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Ten tales of aliens, UFOs and abductions. We'll provide a fresh look at some classic encounters and bring several new stories to light.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate a haunted cottage hidden deep in the heart of Cheshire. Believed to be haunted by a family of ghostly spirits, many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: The SS and The Occult
programme.desc: This powerful film revisits the sites most closely associated with Heinrich Himmler and traces the development of his warped ideology. Heinrich Himmler was the creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. He was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past. The occult roots of the Third Reich are discussed.

programme.title: The Real Merlin
programme.desc: His name conjures up images of a golden age of magic, mystery and chivalry. Of Camelot and the search for the Holy Grail, King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table. But is there any truth behind the myth of Merlin, a man beyond the legend? The Real Merlin finds a sixth-century druid, shaman and right-hand man to the last pagan king, a prophet who predicted his own strange three-fold death.

programme.title: On the Yeti Trail
programme.desc: Does the Yeti really exist? Our film sets out to meet the teams involved in this strange race across the world, and features laboratories, hair analysis, footprints and DNA as well as the search for samples in Indonesia and in Canadian nature reserves. A fascinating and thorough film, featuring, amongst others, French Collège de France paleoanthropologist Pascal Picq.

programme.title: Vampire Skeletons
programme.desc: In summer 2007, at a site in Ireland, archaeologists were uncovering layers of graves. They were astonished to find two skeletons with large stones lodged in their jaws. The archaeologists believe that the skeletons were treated as if they were 'revenants' - individuals who might return from the dead to prey on the living.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Join Richard as he gives us an exclusive sneak peek backstage at the highly secretive annual gathering of the world's richest and most powerful movers and shakers. Richard speaks with many Bilderberg investigators who argue that once behind closed doors, this powerful group plot, conspire and stage-manage world events.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Memphis, Nashville, Fort Worth, Texas, and Washington DC to investigate the theory that Elvis Presley did not die on August 16th, 1977 but faked his death for a variety of reasons. Jokes of Elvis sightings in Kalamazoo, Michigan aside, there is a considerable volume of evidence to suggest Elvis may not have left the building.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: What can lead a military man to draw his service weapon in his own base, and completely unload the magazine of his rifle? In the cases that we are going to analyze, these military men claim to have witnessed the appearance of strange humanoid beings.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Explore mysterious sightings spanning millennia, from ancient rock art to recent encounters. Witness strange lights over Barranco de Badajoz and a peculiar being at 'El Condesito' farm in Huelva. Encounter enigmatic humanoids on Conil beaches. Hear from witnesses to unravel the uncanny connection between past depictions and present sightings.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United States has been involved in a secret conflict with alien forces for the past fifty years. It looks at the Battle of Los Angeles and the Roswell Incident. It also discusses the theory that President Eisenhower made a treaty with alien race.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether time travel is real and, if it is, whether it is under the control of a mysterious elite. It examines the mysterious South Fork Bridge photo which purports to show a man out of time. It also looks at theories that claim that the Nazis developed a time travel device during World War II.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files

programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files counts down the top ten secret societies: (10) The Hellfire Club, (9) The Majestic Twelve, (8) The Knights of the Golden Circle, (7) Opus Dei, (6) The Bohemian Club, (5) Skull and Bones, (4) The Bilderberg Group, (3) The Knights Templar, (2) The Freemasons, and (1) The Illuminati.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at some of the secret government warehouses of the United States. It looks at Fort Knox gold depository and asks whether the gold there has been removed. It also examines Hangar 18 at Wright Patterson Air Force base in Ohio and whether it contains crashed alien craft or the Nazi Die Glocke.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines a conspiracy that may be seeking to eradicate 90% of the world's population. It looks at the Georgia Guidestones built by an unknown architect which call for humanity to reduce its population to below 500 million.

programme.title: Secrets of UFOs
programme.desc: Crop circles have been reported around the globe for more than a century. They appear usually in complete darkness and often instantaneously. Some are clearly hoaxes. Others are inexplicable, with no evidence of human activity. This program asks questions like why do crops undergo changes at the cellular level and what are the strange lights seen over the fields where crop circles are found?

programme.title: Crop Circles: The Mayan Codes Revealed
programme.desc: The Mayan calendar is known and studied by dozens of researches. In fact, many believe it holds a prophetic message, however, its decoding is not yet complete. The mayas were convinced that time is cyclic. Every 5,125 years, an ear would end simultaneously opening a new one. Is it possible that an incredible connection is concealed between the Mayan prophecies and the crop circles?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler set out to conquer the world and he nearly succeeded. But did the Nazis have help from an extraterrestrial source? We'll tell you what Hitler may have been hiding, and where it is now.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: They live and work in your town. In fact, they may be members of your country's government. But they're not who, or what, they appear to be. We'll unseal the truth about these aliens among us and tell you who has come in peace, and who has a far more sinister purpose in mind.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: A mysterious photograph with no plausible explanation. An aborted nuclear launch half a world away. And the continuing appearance of mysterious men in black. What happens when scientific explanations fail us? Could this shocking photo from the 1960's be the proof we're looking for?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: U.S. Presidents are the most powerful men on the planet. But do they know something about extraterrestrials that we don't? We'll explore the complex relationship between Aliens and Presidents.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many people believe we are not alone. But if aliens share this planet, what are their plans for us? We'll unseal the Top 10 Alien Plots and let you know if ET came in peace or if he has something else in mind.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: As the Curiosity Rover searches Mars for signs of life, the question becomes: Could Mars have been first? We'll explore the shocking possibility that sentient life began on Mars and traveled here.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Barrow Green H17 Anti-Aircraft Battery was built to protect the Liverpool Docks. I also acted as a general area and a former prisoner of war camp, and holds some sinister secrets and Ghost Dimension uncover paranormal activity dating back to WW2.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travel to Derbyshire to investigate the New Mills Arts Theatre. This quirky little building has played host to many famous acts and world renowned plays but has a little known secret that it's allegedly Haunted. With unexplained voices coming from the auditorium and shadows witnessed on the stage, The activity will get so intense it will leave the team in a spin!
programme.sub-title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Located in Gran Canaria, there is one house that locals refuse to enter and that is, The House of Fear. Ghostly shadows, loud banging and demonic voices have all been reported here and the Ghost Dimension team will investigate these claims tonight.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Danny Moss has been charged with investigating a haunted house in Middlesbrough in the UK. Rose grew up in the house in the 1970's and 80s which was believed to have been the site of a fatal fire years earlier. She witnessed her first ghost when she was just 7 years old.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Since its origin in 1196, Micklegate Bar, a massive entrance to the city of York, has been host to royal powers, Lords, and also some other guests, those from a world beyond ours.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Founded in 1070, Sussex's Battle Abbey is an ancient British landmark - one steeped in paranormal lore. Many rumors of otherworldly hauntings have followed Battle Abbey through the years.

programme.title: The Other Side: Secrets of the Paranormal World
programme.desc: Pre-titles and the explanation of premise for believer and non-believer. Origins of the Devil which has the explainer and discussion with Matteo Borrini/Deborah Hyde. Derren Brown Interview. Ouija Section, explanation. Christopher French interview. Haunting section/explanation, interview with Derren Brown, Uri Geller and Jayne Harris. Controlled experiments.

programme.title: The Other Side: Secrets of the Paranormal World
programme.desc: A 30 seconds reminder 'last time' American section; visiting Ralph Sarchie, ex NY cop turned Demonologist and Evangelist Exorcist 'Bob Larsson'. This will include explanation of exorcism and also shots from private exorcism sessions. A cut down of pre-titles and titles then. This will be between me and Matthew.

programme.title: The British UFO Files
programme.desc: The British UFO Files tells a story more bizarre than anything to be found within the pages of even the fictional X Files. Featuring eye-witness accounts by top ranking military personnel, previously top secret documentation and rare archive footage, the film examines information ranging from the alleged production of Nazi UFOs to the landing of an alien spacecraft at a British air-force base.

programme.title: Defeating The Devil
programme.desc: The devil's powers, tactics, objectives and limitations, are discussed by several renowned experts in the field of demonic phenomena, including the most famous of all, Fr. Gabriele Amorth, the Official Exorcist of the Diocese of Rome and author of perhaps the definitive scholarly work on demonology. We discover how the devil works, by using temptation, curses, infestations, hexes and possession.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to London to investigate various theories revolving around the tragic death of Diana, The former Princess of Wales. Was the fatal car crash in a Paris tunnel in August 1997 a result of a drunken driver or was she murdered? Was she pregnant with the child of Dodi Al Fayed? Was she perceived as a threat to the Royal Family?
programme.sub-title: The Death of Princess Diana: Tragic Car Accident or Murder Most Foul?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: For years, farmers have been discovering strange geometric patterns comprised of rings, circles and other complex shapes in their fields. Are they calling cards from extraterrestrials? Are they manmade hoaxes? Do they have some religious significance? Richard investigates with the top crop circle researchers in an effort to solve this centuries old mystery.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: The encounters in the fourth phase are terrible; the witness not only sees the alleged ship or its crew, but is taken, generally unconscious or against their will, into said ships. Some, like Próspera Muñoz, who gave us in her last interview, possibly the most credible abduction account in our story, return to tell what happened. She is not the only one, as we will see in this exciting chapter.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: In Dec 1995-Mar 1996, a surge of UFO sightings occurred, notably at Polvorin of As Gándaras, Lugo. Military witnessed triangle lights on infrared cameras, marking our longest and most prolific UFO event. Cases included landings and encounters with mysterious lights and alleged crews. A year prior, 'something' crashed from space in Cando de Arriba mountains, A Coruña, igniting the phenomenon.
programme.sub-title: UFOs in Spain - The Last Great Wave

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: There is a secret government facility accused of creating many diseases currently plaguing our country. Have we unleashed these biological weapons on purpose and if so, is there a secret lab near you?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: There is a battle going on for your mind. From the Cold War to the TV set, someone wants to control what you think, how you act and what you believe. We'll reveal the new practices in mind control and tell you why you need to start paying attention before it's too late.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: It seems the world is fascinated with all things science fiction. First it was vampires, then werewolves, and now Zombies. But could this once seemingly far fetched idea be closer to happening then we ever thought possible? Are zombies becoming a reality?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: New developments in science and research have invented equipment that may have much more sinister capabilities than we are being led to believe. Are governments around the world using weather control to incite the next World War and possibly destroy the planet?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The past few decades have been filled with stunning technological advancement. But is all this 'progress' good for humanity? Animal cloning has been a reality for decades but the disturbing experiments going on behind close doors will shock you. Human cloning may be much closer than you think.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Is this half man, half ape simply a figment of our collective imagination or does he really exist? As the evidence begins to pile up maybe we should be asking: who has been keeping this from us?

programme.title: Christmas Grace
programme.desc: The story of two rival toy store owners during Christmas time. Gary, who runs an honest business and has a good relationship with his customers and has everything is running smoothly until he hears of a new bigger store.

programme.title: The Perfect Gift
programme.desc: A spoiled schoolgirl, her overworked executive mother, and a disillusioned young minister each learns a valuable lesson about community, tradition, and the truest meaning of Christmas from a friendly, but mysterious, drifter named Jess.

programme.title: Christmas Oranges
programme.desc: Experience the journey of Rose, an orphan who teaches hope to all those around her in this poignant Christmas based on a classic holiday tale.

programme.title: The Miracle Of The Cards
programme.desc: There's no such thing as miracles. That's what a skeptical reporter (Kirk Cameron) thought until he met Craig Shergold (Thomas Sangster). Craig is an eight-year-old boy with a brain tumor and less than a year to live. Looking for hope, his mother (Catherine Oxenberg) pushes to break the Guinness World Record for receiving the most get-well cards. They receive an incredible 1.3 million cards and shatter the old record. However Craig continues to get worse.

programme.title: By God's Grace
programme.desc: In the tradition of a classic "A Christmas Carol", this film offers many lessons on the importance of giving and the cause and effect our choices have on others.

programme.title: My Son, My Savior
programme.desc: A powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary. The film imagines Mary's childhood, growing up, celebrating the annual feasts and hearing the prophecies about a coming Messiah who would redeem Israel.

programme.title: Hank's Christmas Wish
programme.desc: "Hank's Christmas Wish" tells the heartwarming tale of a retired elf seeking a life of seclusion. However, his plans are interrupted when a group of unrelentingly cheerful townsfolk, brimming with the holiday spirit, come into his life. Through their unwavering kindness and infectious joy, they help him rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. Packed with yuletide laughter, chestnut-roasting moments, and Jack Frost-nipping faith, this cutesy film captures the essence of the holiday season.

programme.desc: Jennifer Miller, a self-centered teenager, learns the importance of giving during the Christmas season when her mother falls ill with cancer. While working at a homeless shelter, she meets unexpected friends who change her perspective.

programme.desc: Second chances start when a hardened criminal crosses paths with a precocious little girl who is helped by an angel to change hearts during the holiday season.

programme.desc: When an uncaring executive falls from the corporate ladder, he learns how difficult it can be to find work and compassion in today's economy. He eventually accepts a humiliating job, but with bills rapidly piling up, and not enough money to go around, he quickly discovers that, unless something changes soon, he'll lose everything by Christmas. Will family and faith be enough to bring joy when you're Homeless for The Holidays?

programme.desc: Jeremy and Jimmy wear out a pair of tires testing their Trailblazer SS in a drift like fashion. Upgrades are already on their minds as they shed some pounds for a better drifting truck.
programme.sub-title: Stripping Down a 2006 Trailblazer SS to Make It Drift-Worthy

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: LT and Austin take delivery on "Project Lo 'n Slo". Find out what's in store for this 53 year old C-10. Plus loose ends on the Chevy K1500 "RedTide" get tied up including gearing and a rear-end rebuild.
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding the Rear End of a Chevy K1500

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: It's mod-mayhem as we trick out our Trailgater with all the toys you'll need for the ultimate tailgating experience. Eric and Joel use all of the cool features on our 2025 Nissan Frontier to install a fridge, grill, and TV setup so you can have everything you'll need at your fingertips on game day.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our 2001 BMW race car gets a set of coilovers, as well as big brake upgrade. Then we change the aerodynamics of our project to give it a fierce look.
programme.sub-title: Building the Beast - Project UnSanctioned Part 4

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We continue with our aftermarket pump gas 427ci Small Block Chevy engine, with plans on getting it into the Dyno Cell. It's getting finished off with a high flowing, off the shelf induction and rock solid valvetrain before we run some 93-octane fuel thru it and see what it puts out on the Dyno.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle team dives into the EBC Mustang Sweepstakes car, but things may have to get worse before they can get better. The first step is to build a solid foundation for this Resto Mod.
programme.sub-title: Converting The '70 RestoMod Mustang Suspension From Leaf Spring To Coilover

programme.title: HorsePower
programme.desc: Part 2 of HorsePower's dual Ford 351 project, as the guys complete the build of a Cleveland engine and then turn their attention to the Windsor engine. Using some original parts and aftermarket heads and intake, the guys transform the Windsor into a better-performing Clevor (or mock Cleveland).
programme.sub-title: 351 Small Block Dyno Shootout: Windsor vs Cleveland

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: A '78 Postal Jeep gets a second chance as we start turning it into an all around offroad rig starting with a set of 1 ton axles.
programme.sub-title: Junkyard Postal Jeep Delivers With 1 Ton Axles and 4WD

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: E85 fuel promises high-octane performance for almost any engine. We put it to the test in our revamped 360ci "Compression Obsession" Small Block Chevy.
programme.sub-title: Can a Stock Cast SBC Crank live at 7000 RPM and 570+ HP?

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: With over 600 horses the Gen II is ready to pound the pavement! From the street, to the track, to the strip, this split bumper is a beast. We also take you inside the PRI Show to checkout the latest in race engine technology.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The guys measure for the pylons for their new wing. Plus, get the '72 Camaro ready for test and tuning.
programme.sub-title: Road Course Camaro Part 12 Aerodynamic Advantage

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We add some GNX body panels to our '85 Buick Regal. We clean up and update a set of old Camaro/Nova wheels with fresh paint and trim pieces.
programme.sub-title: Fabricating a Buick Regal Custom Bumper

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Once we finish assembly on our improved Compression Obsession 406ci SBC, we'll run this dyno mule through its paces!

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The guys visit DBR Performance and their first chance ever to drive a Jeep TrackHawk, which inspires a plan of their own...to turn an old Wagoneer into a screaming street monster.
programme.sub-title: Putting TrackHawk Power Into A 1986 Jeep Wagoneer

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We take an old-school 302 Ford and bring it into the 21st century with much-needed induction and fuel delivery upgrades.
programme.sub-title: Old School 302 Ford Goes High Tech

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: As part of the Motorsports Team, students at UNOH build high-performance Stock and Modified dirt race cars. On Friday nights, they push them to their limits at Limaland Motorsports Park!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton get cracking on a true piece of 90s muscle, their 1990 Mustang. This Fast Lane Fox Body Stang takes its first ride, before a total makeover that'll turn it from Half-Bred Pony to Thoroughbred Stallion.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We start reassembling our 1985 Chevy K-10 square body. We'll add steering, brakes, exhaust, and glass. Plus restoration components that will make our square body look young again!
programme.sub-title: Faux Guy Square Body Gets Custom 3" Stainless Exhaust

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We lay out our plan to rebuild our 1985 Chevy K-10. We start by tearing it down and building it back up with new sheet metal repair. What we have in mind for this truck will make you do a double-take!
programme.sub-title: The Faux Guy: The Series Premiere

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We take a 1989 OBS Chevy C1500 and fabricate truck bed to fit our new custom Oval track rear suspension. Then we head to the paint booth to add a classic paint job.
programme.sub-title: Our '89 OBS Chevy Sports Truck Gets a Custom Oval Track Rear Suspension

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel give the '69 Road Runner's interior a much-needed makeover. We'll restore the dash and give the seats and headliner some much needed attention.
programme.sub-title: Tackling The Worn Out Road Runner Interior - Part 4

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The warden's calling for diagnostics for Detroit Muscle's next prisoner, their 1969 Pontiac GTO. They'll have to tear down and look inside the skeleton of this old muscle car before they fix it up.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Chrome is where the heart is - Tommy and Joel update the bright work on their '71 Chevy Caprice and they'll visit the chrome plater to break down how the new bling comes into being.
programme.sub-title: '71 Chevy Caprice Gets Perfectly Polished Chrome

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Budgets spent and trucks built, the Ford and Ram go head to head to compare baseline numbers with those after all upgrades. Who will win? Austin's Eco, or LT's Viper.
programme.sub-title: Who Wins Dyno Test? V10 SRT10 or Twin-Turbo V6 F150?

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: We're on the trail! We are taking our Jeep JL to Burning Rock Off Road park, and the Hatfield McCoy Trail system in West Virginia to see just how dirty our Jeep can get!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Project Hard Charger gets the front end buttoned up and we help a viewer restore his cranky Camaro.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: In the series launch we take a 1991 Chevy Suburban and transform it into 'Project Unbreakable.' We test the Suburban at on off-road track, then return to the studio to tear it down to the frame, create a full build-plan, get the engine work underway, and begin fabrication.
programme.sub-title: Can We Make This Stock '91 Suburban Unbreakable?

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Our Silverado is still in the shop getting a few more modifications. We'll add our fuel and brake lines, plus fabricate our double duty exhaust on our frame. We'll strip down the cab inside and out. Then, we'll work on the truck bed to make way for some custom touches like a roll pan and a DIY bed cover.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We're starting with a high-mileage 5.3L Vortec that we got on the cheap. Our goal: make as much horsepower as we can, spending the least money possible.
programme.sub-title: Minor Upgrades Create Crazy Power on a Junkyard 5.3L Vortec

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: A high-compression 632 ci Big Block Chevy provides massive power for XOR's Willys Wagon.

programme.title: Carcass

programme.title: Engine Power

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets a stronger axle, and a custom built bumper. Plus, how you can build your own rack for trail tools.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: On the Gower Peninsula, Jeremy makes spicy Xinjiang Lamb and Mixed Veg Skewers, followed by a beautiful, spicy Steamed Plum Pudding. Jeremy starts with mouthwatering Sichuanese Chicken.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: Jeremy begins with Chili Oil Noodles, while Joe Swash seeks to master Kung Pao Chicken. Jeremy also receives a masterclass in filleting before firing up the catch of the day on the beach.

programme.title: The Healthy Voyager
programme.desc: Carolyn Scott-Hamilton showcases the best of Baja, Mexico including prime locations to stay, exceptional sites to visit, and unique restaurants specializing in plant-based vegan food that will satisfy

programme.title: Secrets of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Meet a survivor of Hurricane Irma in the U.S. Virgin Islands who has been embraced by her community, visit the historic Brimstone Fortress Hill, dine on delicious food in the Tobago Cays, and experience underwater brilliance in St. Barts.

programme.title: The World's Most Expensive Cruise Ship
programme.desc: Executive Head Chef Ronald visits a local fish market in Bergen to source produce to wow the guests. Regents food Tsar and Senior Culinary Director, Bernhard Klotz is also arriving on board, so Ronald will have to bring his A-game.

programme.title: The Millionaires' Holiday Club
programme.desc: Richard and Martyn have been together for 16 years and have stayed at some of the most luxurious destinations in the world; but for their next holiday Richard wants to go somewhere extra special as he's planning a surprise; whether it's at their £10,000 a week private villa on the Sandy Lane estate, the A-list celebrity hang out in Barbados, or on the idyllic island of Mustique, the only challenge Richard now faces is picking the right moment to propose.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Proper Pub Food
programme.desc: For many of us, we savor our hearty Sunday lunches at our favorite pub, and Tom would like to show us how to make them even more special. He starts with a classic roast beef, and ends with a lemon posset pudding, and a chocolate ale cake.

programme.title: The Healthy Voyager
programme.desc: Carolyn Scott-Hamilton showcases the best of the Seychelles including prime locations to stay, exceptional sites to visit, and unique restaurants specializing in plant-based vegan food that will satisfy the healthy traveler in you.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, New York: Join Anthony Bourdain on his quest to characterize the perfect bar. With him, discover the importance of a "maniacal bartender", the proper chemical makeup of drinks, the joys of seedy dive-bars, and the need for late night snacks.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Salvador, Brazil: Known as Brazil's capital of happiness, Salvador da Bahia offers fruitful local markets and rich Bahian cuisine: fried shrimp, palm oil, chili peppers, and coconut. Here, Tony takes part in a tradional ceremony, and experiences the culinary talents of the famous Bahian, Chef Dada.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal - Portuguese cuisine holds a dear place in Tonys culinary heart.Tony travels to Porto, home of the famous Port wine, where he is immediately exposed to the codfish and the almost mythical place it holds in Portuguese cuisine and culture.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Cambodia: With a friend along for the ride, Tony travels to Phnom Penh, Cambodia, where he explores a food culture that is both pleasing to the palette and slightly frightening.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Los Angeles - CA, New York chef, Anthony Bourdain, descends into the culinary underbelly of his metropolitan nemesis, Los Angeles, where he experiences the trials of celebrity fame and the joys of West Coast cuisine.
programme.sub-title: Los Angeles, My Own Heart of Darkness

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Sydney, Australia: Bourdain embarks on a pilgrimage through Australia to indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs, Tetsuya Wakuda. Days, miles and many Australian meals later, Anthony finds himself unable to describe Tetsuya's delicious and well-earned meal.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Cambodia and Japan: Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on earth. After his journey, Tony returns to Japan.
programme.sub-title: Eating on the Edge of Nowhere

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Brazil: What is Carioca? These natives of Rio de Janeiro are lovable scamps who somehow find ways to avoid work altogether, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars. Mr. Bourdain, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try, enjoying a savage tan, Brazilian barbecue, and one too many Caipirinhas!

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Puebla, Mexico - According to Tony, the best line cooks in NYC come from Mexico, so he travels to the Puebla, and enjoys mole sauces, toasted ant eggs, fried worms, and the legendary pulque (a slightly hallucinogenic drink made from cactus sap).
programme.sub-title: Puebla, Where the Good Cooks Are From

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Mekong River, Vietnam: On the river, Tony drinks a lot of Mekong moonshine with the welcoming owners of a duck farm. Although seduced by his Vietnam experience, Tony is not sure the royal dish Birds Nest Soup is all its cracked up to be.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: San Sebastian, Spain: Tony explores the food-crazed Basque culture. Tony's guide, Chef Luis Irizar, takes Tony into the underworld of Basque gastronomic societies. Later, Tony explores the citys tapas bars.
programme.sub-title: San Sebastian: A Food Lover's Town

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Hanoi, Vietnam: Tony returns to his beloved Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday, Tet. Together, the friends enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo where he discovers a radically new cooking attitude. He visits Tokyos largest fresh fish market and is introduced to the culinary diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: London, England - In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.desc: Reformed criminal and ace martial artist Bruce decides to go straight and settle down with his girlfriend after being released from prison. Trouble ensues when the gang he used to be part of kidnaps the daughter of an American ambassador.

programme.title: Duel of Flying Kicks
programme.desc: A corrupt mayor of a town in Szechuan province allies himself with a group of bandits to gain control of the region by cutting off all supply routes to the town. Two policemen, both expert kickers are deployed to put an end to the mayor's evil plot.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 3 - Licensed to Terminate
programme.desc: Alpha, the Prince of Justice, is born to save the world from darkness and to protect mankind from the evil forces of the Black Ninja Empire, and the fearless and powerful Ninja Gordon has been chosen by his dying master to stop the nefarious Ninja Temple from killing this child. Gordon and Temple must confront each other in an ultimate showdown, using the ancient techniques of ninja combat at its best.

programme.title: Bandits, Prostitutes and Silver
programme.desc: A carriage driver, Wang Tao, gets entangled with thieves when he wants to liberate a prostitute. Double dealing and lies befall them all.

programme.title: The Clutch of Power
programme.desc: A swordsman known as "Soul of the Sword" has been hired by the Mongolian General to wipe out any Chinese patriots who stand in the way of the Mongol invasion. Leung Kar-Yan comes of best with his lethal spear blade which he uses with great dexterity.

programme.title: Iron Fisted Eagle Claw
programme.desc: Kung Fu superstars Chi Kuan Chun and Bruce Liang, star in this brilliant kung fu flick. Local gangster San gets arrested by Police Officer Liu. While San's accomplices try to free him, the two rascals Chu and Pan foil their plan. Unfortunately, San still finds a way to escape and swears revenge on Liu and his family. Liu's wife gets murdered, Liu gets kidnapped and only Chu and Pan can save the day, but have to face the might of Chen Sing's deadly iron fist.

programme.title: Evil Destroyer
programme.desc: Father Luke Daniels tries to stop the flow of opium into his country but finds himself facing off against the evil Mr. Wu and 'Blackstone, a man who isn't afraid to use clown ninjas and hopping vampires to get his way.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: A woman beseeches a man to carryout the revenge he was ordered to do, but a new woman in his life refuses to let him go back to his old ways. Our group of travelers get pulled into the affair during their journeys.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 16

programme.title: Master of Flying Daggers
programme.desc: Night Orchid is a notorious nickname attributed to a mysterious character that kills women, leaving an orchid as a signature after the murder. Only the Master of flying daggers, Chu Liu Hsiang can solve the mystery and restore peace to the martial world.

programme.title: The Ultimate Ninja
programme.desc: A twenty year old feud between an evil tyrant, Roger, and Ronald, the benevolent village leader, leaves Ronald dead and Roger running the village with an evil menacing bunch of ruffians. Years later the orphaned children are reunited when an evil ninja steals the Black Ninja Warrior from the Red Ninjas. If he gets a hold of the Golden Ninja Warrior a rule of tyranny will be unleashed upon the country, and only the three can stop him.

programme.title: Fearless Golden Dragon
programme.desc: Corruption is rife in old-time China. Wang Yun rules with an Iron Fist. Enter the Fearless Golden Master and watch him liberate the town in an explosion of incredible and dynamic kung fu fighting. Raging kicks and fists!

programme.title: 72 Desperate Rebels
programme.desc: A true classic! An all star cast with untold weapons! The Emperor's spy (Wei Tze-Yung), the daughter of the killed governor Shih Han (Wei Hai-Min), a mysterious mercenary (Wan Shan) and a blind swordsman (Lung Fei) team up to defeat chief pirate (Bai Ying), leader of the 72 Desperate Rebels, but eventually it will be his daughter (Yang Hsiu-Chian) who will decide at the end of the movie. This superb martial arts movie has nice imaginative touches and a very good planning direction.

programme.title: Magnificent Kick
programme.desc: Two sisters, seeking vengeance on a local General for killing their father, ask Wong Fei Hung to teach them his Shadow Less Kick, believing it will help them defeat the General in combat. When Master Wong refuses for pacifist reasons, the sisters try to trick his students, Club Foot Seven and Butcher Wing into helping them.

programme.title: Golden Showdown
programme.desc: You'll know them when you see them! Returning to his home town and finding it overrun with ruthless gangsters led by Mr Chore, Richard sets out to stop their nefarious activities. A bloody conflict ensues, and when Richard's father is killed in retaliation he finds out that the law is no better. But then his sister is killed and Richard finally snaps, taking on the gang single-handedly and loaded to the very last bullet.

programme.title: Double Dragon Last Duel aka Double Dragon in Last Duel
programme.desc: You think you've won the final victory, but the most dreadful nightmare is waiting for you! Kir, an expert in the martial arts gets the job of escorting the government's payroll, and is befriended by a seemingly heroic fighter, Wang, who is in fact the leader of a gang of bandits. When the chance comes, Wang kills Kir's family and grabs all his property, but the son escapes. Years later, Dragon seeks revenge for the injustice to his father in a duel to the death.

programme.title: Kung Fu from Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: Rare Billy film! Watch him fight Lo Lieh and demons! On the 7th month of the lunar calendar, all ghosts and spirits are active and get to walk the earth for a month so that they can find a way to reincarnate. During one of these nights, a young kid named Chun Sing (Billy Chong), is visited by his dead Father. Chun Sing's father states that he was murdered by a man named Kam Tai Fu (Lo Lieh). And as you may have guessed, Chun Sing must avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Revenger
programme.desc: TI LUNG stars as the Kung Fu warrior Shao Tu, dedicated to help the oppressed, but who makes many deadly enemies along the way. One of which is Mao (Wong Ching) who with his army of fighters hatches a deadly plot to bring about the downfall of Shao Tu.

programme.title: 18 Fatal Strikes
programme.desc: The action is incredible in this great kung fu classic. An Abbot Monk is injured and ends up in the home of two young men, and soon are targets of the Ching Army and evil leader Wong Wu Ti. They acquire skills from the Abbot and the battle begins...

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Ernie Reyes
programme.desc: This unique documentary reveals the life of pioneer Ernie Reyes. Raised in poverty and prejudice, he was able to persevere. Through decades of vigorous training, he became one of the top nationally rated competitors in both forms and fighting. He is the chief instructor and co-founder of one of the biggest and most successful schools in the world, the West Coast World Martial Arts.

programme.title: Dragon and Snake in the Spider's Web
programme.desc: Security Officer Lu (Tan Tao Liang) is following a case of a mysterious gun smuggler. His investigations lead him to Madam Wu, who appears to be the link between smuggler and client. Luckily for Lu, Wu seems to have a soft spot for the womanizing gambler known as Chang (Wong Tao) so Lu arrests him in the hope that, with a little brute force, he will assist in the case.

programme.title: Eagle vs Silver Fox
programme.desc: After the downfall of the Manchu Dynasty, the surviving officials plan to restore order across China. One of these men, Silver Fox, hires the best fighters in the country to assassinate those who were responsible for the revolution and destroy all martial arts schools. To combat this menace the various schools band together and nominate Chow Fung, master of the Eagle form, to face the might of the Silver Fox in a one-on-one bone-breaking showdown.

programme.title: The Shaolin Kid
programme.desc: Andre, an eight-year-old American boy has just one dream: to be a Kungfu master like Jackie Chan. When he gets the chance to enter the legendary Shaolin Temple, his father takes the heartbreaking decision to follow his son to China. While father and son face the unknown together, the mother they left behind now faces life without her family. All three members of the family, husband, wife, and son now face their own unique set of challenges along this martial arts journey.

programme.title: Return of Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Pai Wu Chin (Bruce Pak) is a stranger in town who is on a mission to find out the whereabouts of his missing brother (Bruce Le), who rumor has it, was murdered by the chief inspector of police. Pei Chiu Ting is the brother of the ex-chief inspector and is now the head samurai who wants Pai Wu killed on site. Non-stop action follows when Pai Wu meets Po Zu Pai, who together faces their common enemy and fights the samurai clan.

programme.title: Dynamo
programme.desc: Bruce Li is hired by a talent agency to become the next big martial arts star, due to his resemblance to Bruce Lee. However, a rival agency becomes jealous of Bruce's success, and attempts to have him killed. See Bruce Li fight karate legend Steve Sanders!

programme.title: The Iron Man
programme.desc: Chin (Wang Yu), whose family was killed and his left hand cut off by a brutal Japanese general Fang Woo (Lung Fei) during the occupation of China in World War II. After 12 years of training in kung fu, Chin travels to Japan to seek revenge on those who wronged him and his family. Action packed one armed classic!

programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

An infantry regiment and tanks attack but are stopped by heavy mortar fire. A small squad succeeds by using grenades and .45 submachine guns, allowing the tanks and infantry to take the town after a fierce fight. Stars actor Jim Hutton.

U.S. Captain Tom Ryan and Sergeant Steve Maycheck, decide to rescue the orphans and the Baroness, leading to a thrilling climax.

For 9 months, the Allies struggled to take the Gustav Line and the abbey of Monte Cassino. In May 1944, the Gustav Line finally collapsed, with the Second Polish Corps succeeding in capturing the abbey. The Allies had paid a big price, but now the road to Rome was open.

The concept of 'total war' becomes reality, with cities bombed into oblivion, resources stretched to their limits, and entire societies mobilized for the war effort. Strategic bombing campaigns against Germany and Japan begin to devastate industrial centers and civilian morale alike.

Weighing 70,000 tonnes and armed with 150 guns, it faced the U.S. naval aviation, including aircraft carriers USS Essex and USS Yorktown. In a fierce battle, American pilots focused on one goal: sink the Yamato. This marked a turning point in WWII naval warfare.

This creates unique images of the dictator's public appearances and his private life on Obersalzberg. Scanned in high-resolution HD, the footage of Hitler and his entourage unfolds a particularly realistic effect.

During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash (Danny DeVito) immediately suspects murder rather than an accident.
