programme.title: Return to the Hiding Place
programme.desc: When the Nazis begin killing Jews in Holland, a group of youth fight to save the lives of the innocent.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: The unique story of Nelson Mandela's early years. Born in one of the most rural parts of South Africa, Mandela is adopted by the Thembu royalty after the death of his father. But the lure of the city is more powerful than an aristocratic lifestyle in the country, and Mandela flees to Johannesburg.

programme.title: Discovering Apostle Paul
programme.desc: Paul or Saul as he was known before his conversion, was a 'Pharisee of the Pharisees'. He was passionate about his Jewish faith and was committed to getting rid of new cults like Christianity. Saul set out for Damascus to imprison any Christians he found there but was dramatically converted by an encounter with the living Christ. Saul the persecutor became Paul the preacher.

programme.title: Mysteries of Noah and The Flood
programme.desc: The Biblical tale of Noah and the Flood holds an unmatched fascination for people of all ages and cultures. The search for irrefutable evidence of a flood so overwhelming that it divided known history into BEFORE and AFTER...and the search for the Ark itself...have long consumed scientists, explorers, religious scholars and artists.

programme.title: My Son My Savior
programme.desc: From the makers of the award winning biblical dramas, Road to Emmaus and Come Follow Me, comes My Son, My Savior, a powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary.

programme.title: The Case For Faith
programme.desc: In The Case for Faith, legally trained investigative reporter Lee Strobel investigates two of the most emotional objections to Christianity. Barriers to faith confronted by believers and skeptics alike; Why is Jesus the only way to God? And how could a loving God exist if there is evil and suffering in the world?

programme.title: The Perfect Race
programme.desc: Allee-Sutton Hethcoat reprises her role as Coach Courtney Smith-Donnelly from 'Remember The Goal' in 'The Perfect Race'. She works with a female athlete at a small Christian college who tries to overcome long odds and win a national title in the 800 meter run. Coach Donnelly's training methods and teachings about life both line up with the concept that in order to win...you first have to lose.

programme.title: Princess Cut
programme.desc: A lifelong Carolina farm girl, now in her early 20's, Grace has dreamed all her life of the day when "Mr. Right" slips a Princess Cut diamond on her finger and swears to love her forever. Tonight may be that night as Stewart has something special planned after 15 months together! But when things don't go as planned, and romance crashes down around her, it launches her on a quest, aided by her father, to understand what it means to truly love another person.

programme.title: The Life of Jesus
programme.desc: Perhaps the best drama about the life of Jesus based on the Gospel of John

programme.title: Return to the Hiding Place
programme.desc: When the Nazis begin killing Jews in Holland, a group of youth fight to save the lives of the innocent.

programme.title: Time Changer
programme.desc: The year is 1890 and Bible Professor Russell Carlisle has written a manuscript and is set to receive an unanimous endorsement from the board at Grace Bible Seminary. Professor Carlisle's friend and colleague, Dr. Norris Anderson dissents, raising an objection. Using a secret time machine, Anderson sends Carlisle over 100 years into the future, offering him a glimpse of where his beliefs will lead.

programme.title: Unidentified
programme.desc: An incident occurs in a small Texas town. A man, while driving at night home on a back highway, claims to have encountered a UFO. Two reporters from a national magazine are sent to investigate; their editor wants to publish a story on the controversial subject of UFOs. Brad (Josh Adamson) thinks they're a hoax but Keith (Jonathan Aube) senses that something is out there. What follows is a quest by each man to prove the other wrong. Are UFOs real? A hoax? Is there an explanation?

programme.title: The Perfect Race
programme.desc: Allee-Sutton Hethcoat reprises her role as Coach Courtney Smith-Donnelly from 'Remember The Goal' in 'The Perfect Race'. She works with a female athlete at a small Christian college who tries to overcome long odds and win a national title in the 800 meter run. Coach Donnelly's training methods and teachings about life both line up with the concept that in order to win...you first have to lose.

programme.title: Power of the Air
programme.desc: A Missionary from Africa comes to the United States and shares with a concerned Christian how he feels the church in America is being deceived and in great danger. The Christian is very convicted by what he hears, makes a significant change in his life, and then sets forth a plan to reach his city with the gospel.

programme.title: The Secrets of Jonathan Sperry
programme.desc: Best buddies Dustin (Jansen Panettiere), Albert and Mark are twelve year old boys looking forward to a summer of fun in 1970. When Dustin mows the lawn of seventy-five year old Jonathan Sperry (Gavin MacLeod), a man he has seen at church, a unique friendship develops. What happens the rest of this summer is something Dustin and his friends will never forget!

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: The book of Esther tells the story of a beautiful orphan who hides her Jewish identity, becomes Queen of Persia and saves her people from destruction. A controversial figure, Esther has been criticized for being a 'bad Jew'; flouting tradition, marrying a gentile and being vengeful and bloodthirsty. Still, with great courage, wisdom and imagination, she stops a pogrom.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: No biblical woman is more reviled than Jezebel. Her name is still synonymous with feminine evil. Jezebel's story is a rich mix of historical events, allegorical interpretation and metaphorical licence. At the climax of her long struggle to bring pagan worship to the kingdom of Israel, Queen Jezebel paid a terrible price.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: The story of Eve opens with a vision of loneliness, companionship, desire and love. It tells how woman, made in the creator's image, gives up a life of ease in an idyllic setting, along with the promise of immortality, and instead chooses to pursue wisdom and intimacy with her man. We also consider how stereotypes of Eve haunt our societal view of women today.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: The setting: a late afternoon in Jerusalem 3,000 years ago. A beautiful young woman bathes on the roof at dusk, spied by the lustful eyes of a hidden admirer. The admirer, King David, is supposed to be on the battlefield with his troops. And the woman, Bathsheba, is married. Her husband is a general in David's army.

45365 explores the congruities of daily life in an American town. From the patrol car to the courtroom, the playground to the nursing home, the parade to the prayer service, it explores relationships and interactions - with people and their environment. programme.sub-title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang

programme.sub-title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh

programme.sub-title: Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong

programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and alioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: In Portugal, in the Douro River Valley, a steam locomotive and a small historic train will take you in turn to the water's edge, on the only railroad line in the world that crosses three World Heritage Sites classified by UNESCO.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: The Cinque Terre Express runs along Italy's northern coast east of Genoa; passing through five UNESCO-listed villages, it offers coastal views and access to cobbled streets, harbors, terraced vineyards and pastel-colored houses.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: In Greece, the Intercity Express travels from Thessaloniki to Athens, passing sites like the Meteora peaks, Delphi ruins and the Acropolis; the journey continues to the Peloponnese on Greece's last cogwheel train.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

programme.title: Lethal Love Affair
programme.desc: Krystal Dunbar, is promoted as the youngest department head at her computer firm, after only four months. Loving her career, Krystal has convinced herself that her job is more important than a relationship. But, after an encounter with Zoey Kendricks, a beautiful and mysterious new arrival to town, Krystal's world is turned upside down. When their brief romance begins to conflict with Krystal's career aspirations, she quickly halts the relationship, sending Zoey's emotions spiraling downward.

programme.title: The States
programme.desc: Juice (Jah) is an ambitious Belizean immigrant, who flees to the US. After committing a crime in his country, he learns the hard way that the States is a lot different than what he fantasized. After a string of unfortunate events and violent acts, Juice finally realizes what is most important in life... and in The States.

programme.title: Behind Closed Doors
programme.desc: Stacy is a freshman at a Historic Black College & University. She Meets and falls in love with a Grad Student named Benjamin. He's nice and charming at first. Until he starts to control her and physically, psychologically, and verbally abuse her. Can Stacy get out of this domestic violence relationship before it's too late?

programme.title: Dirty Cops LA
programme.desc: Ex-hustler turned cop, Detective Jackson and his Partner Detective Johnson, an ex-gang member turned shady do-gooder, bring a new meaning to the phrase "boys-in-blue". Normally pre-occupied with robbing and assaulting the city's criminal element, they also make time to close a few cases along the way. The city has been taken over by an outsider known as "El Jefe", a Mexican drug lord that has decided to make LA his new home. Jackson and Johnson plan on helping him get "settled in".

programme.title: Scam City
programme.desc: In New York City, where the hustlers never sleep, comes a new world and new money. The new trap stars in the hood are the scammers living a life of luxury with their new money, expensive cars and pretty women. But they say money is the root of all evil, and some OG drug dealers from Bed-Stuy ain't liking how it's going down. They have become envious of the young scammers, and now the war is on for the money and the fame, and scamming is now the name of the game... or is it? Welcome to Scam City.

programme.title: A Masquerade Trapp
programme.desc: This pastor is a pimp; hustling through Christian dating apps. His pimp game is strong, and he's loved by all the ladies of the night. Until another pimp's woman leaves him, to be with the pastor. From the pulpit to the strip, pimpin' ain't easy.

programme.title: Loose Screws
programme.desc: When Cory gets put out for cheating he ends up living with his cousin Lance who just broke up with his gold digging girlfriend. Thinking they will be some female magnets the two can't get a decent date to save their lives until they find RIGHTMATCH.COM

programme.title: Soulful and Funny Episode 2 Coaches Box
programme.desc: Get hyped and head over with us to The Coaches Box in Duncanville, Texas, a Dallas suburb known for it's local sports legacy. Owner and operator Reginald Heath takes you on a journey to goal-winning and high-scoring delicious home-cooked fresh food alongside comedian D. Elli$.

programme.title: Music & Murder
programme.desc: Not every rags to riches story arrives via a clean cut straight and narrow path. Sometimes long after the rags have been replaced with Versace, the stench from the counterfeit mindset lingers longer than a starlet would like.

programme.title: Why Women Trip
programme.desc: Zori Johnson falls in love hard and fast, yet always seems to be hurt by those closest to her. When she meets the man of her dreams, their love connection spurs her to open her heart once again. But at what cost?

programme.title: Plenty
programme.desc: Rae Jones is a talented, edgy, street-forged sexy 20-something, desperate to become a working actress. After years of dead end auditions and exploitation in music videos, she finally gets the break of a lifetime. But can she maintain the balance between the greedy Hollywood demands of being a rising young star with the indebtedness she feels to her often-unscrupulous family and the seedy Atlanta strip club where she was discovered?

programme.title: When Love Comes Knocking
programme.desc: Veronica Richardson, a girl who has never been with a good man, is caught off guard when true love finds its way to her doorstep. It is up to her if she wants to let it in or shut it out. Damaged and heartbroken from a past childhood friend, Veronica had lost all hope to ever be able to love again.

programme.title: And They Named Her Love
programme.desc: Love, a hopeless romantic painter, sets out on a cross country journey to find herself in the competitive world of artistry. When a near death experience brings Atlanta based songstress Nasada into her life, she goes on a journey to find out that love and business do not always mix.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Christmas
programme.desc: An entire family has lost faith in Christmas, and everything that comes with it, until the youngest in the family reminds them all that the spirit of Christmas is more than just giving and receiving presents.

programme.title: Endless Summer
programme.desc: Keith has spent his whole life dreaming about Alicia. On his last day in town he tries desperately to be noticed by her, but his plans get foiled by his embarrassing grandmother, bullying sister, demanding father, and Alicia's 'player' boyfriend.

programme.title: Gutter
programme.desc: Raised in poverty, Gutter realizes thriving in this world, means embracing the streets that made him.

programme.title: Sons Of The City
programme.desc: Sons of the City tells the story of Joe Young, an inner city college student with a bright future thrown into a war he does not want to fight yet cannot find the courage to leave. More than a coming of age film about urban decay, Sons of the City is about a young man's psychological and emotional journey as he deals with romance, violence, drugs, and urban culture.

programme.title: 3 Way
programme.desc: Marcus and Rachel are a happily married couple living in Houston, TX. They decide to heat up their sex life by bringing in another woman into their bedroom. Once the 3 Way happens, lies, sex, and deceit comes into play. Can their marriage survive?

programme.title: Counterplay
programme.desc: Antwan Walker and his beautiful wife Nia have the perfect marriage. When Antwan's wandering eye leads him to flirt with his co-worker Monica, what follows is a psychological thriller as Antwan slowly realizes that Monica has a hidden agenda.

programme.title: Killer Baby Daddy
programme.desc: Ciera and her baby daddy Byron are not getting along after she catches him on the phone with another woman. Ciera tries to make the relationship work but Byron doesn't want to change his ways. Ciera decides to call it quits with Byron. While jogging in the park one day, Ciera runs into her high school sweetheart, Curtis. When Byron finds out about Ciera's new man, he begins to destroy everything in her life. Ciera must protect her baby and her life before Byron kills everyone she loves.

programme.title: Dirty Cops LA
programme.desc: Ex-hustler turned cop, Detective Jackson and his Partner Detective Johnson, an ex-gang member turned shady do-gooder, bring a new meaning to the phrase "boys-in-blue". Normally pre-occupied with robbing and assaulting the city's criminal element, they also make time to close a few cases along the way. The city has been taken over by an outsider known as "El Jefe", a Mexican drug lord that has decided to make LA his new home. Jackson and Johnson plan on helping him get "settled in".

programme.title: Scam City
programme.desc: In New York City, where the hustlers never sleep, comes a new world and new money. The new trap stars in the hood are the scammers living a life of luxury with their new money, expensive cars and pretty women. But they say money is the root of all evil, and some OG drug dealers from Bed-Stuy ain't liking how it's going down. They have become envious of the young scammers, and now the war is on for the money and the fame, and scamming is now the name of the game... or is it? Welcome to Scam City.

programme.title: His Masterpiece
programme.desc: Victoria and Richard are divorced spouses that operate an art gallery together. After meeting young artist Daniel at a community event, they decide to collaborate with him on the exhibit to generate income for their tax obligations. However, Richard's aggressive nature and ulterior motives soon come to light, leading to a dangerous jealousy within him.

programme.title: Murder Gardens 2
programme.desc: After serving 10 years in prison, Chase returns to Miami Gardens with a goal of reclaiming his life. But the criminal empire that he was once part of has changed and his older brother Rell is now one of the heads in charge. He recruits Chase for one last job, but things are about to spiral out of control.

programme.title: Lethal Love Affair
programme.desc: Krystal Dunbar, is promoted as the youngest department head at her computer firm, after only four months. Loving her career, Krystal has convinced herself that her job is more important than a relationship. But, after an encounter with Zoey Kendricks, a beautiful and mysterious new arrival to town, Krystal's world is turned upside down. When their brief romance begins to conflict with Krystal's career aspirations, she quickly halts the relationship, sending Zoey's emotions spiraling downward.

programme.title: When Girls Ride
programme.desc: When Samantha leaves the South to have a fresh start with her husband, she ends up meeting two biker girls named Raquel and Tammy. The three women grow close, and decide to start their own women's bike club. Things take a turn for the worse when they lose a girl from their group to violence. The women respond accordingly in order to get justice for their friend.

programme.title: It Is What It Is
programme.desc: Victoria, a sophisticated young woman, is trying to find happiness with a good man in the midst of drugs and violence in the mean streets of KC.

programme.desc: Determined that the Ryan empire continues despite Nick's death, Harry quickly sets about organising his grandson's future, while Alex goes a.w.o.l after Nick's life celebration.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Homeless and saved from almost certain death by a hospital staff, Lucas (Paul Dano) has nowhere to turn. The hospital staffers, though, are so taken with his kindness and generosity that they take up a collection to give him a fresh start. But when he's discharged, Lucas meets some fellow homeless people and gives away all the money he's just received. His roommate at the hospital, Jacques (Brian Cox), is also affected by the young man, and offers him a job at his bar.

programme.title: Experimenter

programme.title: Mister America
programme.desc: Despite being completely inexperienced and broke and having just defeated a murder charge, a man mounts a campaign to unseat the San Bernardino district attorney.

programme.title: Diggers
programme.desc: During the 1970s as corporate fisheries begin snatching up water rights around the Hamptons, independent clammers Hunt (Paul Rudd) and his friends can do little else but watch their way of life slip away. While members of the group look for ways to cope, Hunt begins a summer romance with a young vacationer (Lauren Ambrose).

programme.title: The Great Buck Howard
programme.desc: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable (Colin Hanks) looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard (John Malkovich), a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale vs Evil
programme.desc: Two scruffy pals' (Tyler Labine, Alan Tudyk) backwoods vacation takes a bloody turn when ignorant college students mistake them for a pair of murderous hillbillies.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: After hearing that her boyfriend/pimp cheated on her while she was in jail, a transgender sex worker and her best friend set out to find him and teach him and his new lover a lesson.

programme.title: First Date
programme.desc: Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Two college buddies reunite after a decade apart. Ben (Mark Duplass) is married and planning to start a family; Andrew (Joshua Leonard), a free spirit, has spent the last 10 years traveling the globe. Reigniting the rivalries of their college years, the friends agree to enter a movie in an upcoming amateur porn festival. Ben and Andrew's constant need to one-up each other results in a daring proposition: The staunchly heterosexual friends must star together in a gay adult film.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt (Seann William Scott) has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.

programme.title: Skate Kitchen
programme.desc: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes dramatically when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders. As she journeys deeper into this raw New York City subculture, she begins to understand the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: Touchy Feely
programme.desc: A dentist (Josh Pais) gains the ability to heal his patients' physical pain while his sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), a massage therapist, develops an aversion to touching and being touched.

programme.title: The Square
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when a curator hires a public relations team to build some buzz for his renowned Swedish museum.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: I Am Love
programme.desc: At a dinner -- during which her husband, Tancredi (Pippo Delbono), learns that he and his son Edoardo Recchi Jr. (Flavio Parenti) are about to assume control of the Edoardo Recchi Sr.'s (Gabriele Ferzetti) lucrative business -- Emma (Tilda Swinton) meets a chef named Antonio (Edoardo Gabbriellini). Antonio and Emma soon find themselves in bed together. With the family already divided over the elder Recchi's unusual plans, Emma's affair is the wild card that might divide the family for good.

programme.title: A Long Way Down

programme.title: Italian Studies

His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia talks about growing up and family traditions in this episode. Featured recipes include Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a Roasted Garlic Crostini and Papperdelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms. A refreshing "Panache" is shared with her mother Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her flagship restaurant's favorite recipes that can be made at home. They include "gnudi" (Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings); and a flavorful Whole Roasted Branzino. She'll also be talking "restaurant secrets" with some of her chefs in this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta with pear and pecorino is a restaurant favorite at Felidia, and Lidia shows how to take that flavor combination and use it in a risotto. She also demonstrates Short Ribs Braised in Barolo with Orzo.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia reminisces about her Grandma's cantina (cellar) and how she spent every summer helping her grandmother prepare the food from the bounty of the harvest for the fall and winter months. Lidia's cantina has evolved into a pantry, and in this episode she will prepare pantry friendly dishes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavor in the kitchen, as Italians began to grow their produce in America. Lidia makes a Belgian & Red Endive Salad as well as a sweet Cherry Jam Tart wrapped up in an almond crust.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Ingredients that were foraged included asparagus, mushrooms, clams, and mussels, and this seasonal adventure was always extremely exciting. Lidia begins with a hearty Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu. She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode is all about corn. Lidia often played in corn fields, helped with the harvests, and even slept on mattresses made from husks. Recipes for today include a refreshing Corn and Zucchini Minestra, a sweet and savory Polenta Cacio e Pere, and a combination of vegetables that can be served as a side dish or even the highlight of the dinner table- Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.
programme.sub-title: Corn: From the Kernel to the Husk

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the sea growing up near the Adriatic's beautiful rocky beaches. Fishing trips with Uncle Emilio were always a lot of hard work, but definitely worth the delicious reward. Today, she prepares a Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis, Toasted Bread with Basil Cannellini, and a Whole Roasted Branzino where everything is done in the oven for a trouble-free cleanup.
programme.sub-title: Fishing the Adriatic with Uncle Emilio

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says "Family Time " Pork and Grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu, she prepares Pork Medallions with grapes, Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Ornage in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Are you always in rush to prepare soemthing quick yet delicious for dinnertime? In this episode Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas-all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or quick dinner. They include Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms, Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives, Tuna with Mimosa Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.
programme.sub-title: Garlic and Onion Steal the Show

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer .Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.
programme.sub-title: A Little Spice With A Hint of Beer

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has enjoyed clamming with the locals in Le Marche as well as in Long Island, and in this episode she shares two of her most popular dishes: Pappa al Pomodoro with Clams is based on the Tuscan classic-tomato and bread soup. Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has shared her love for gnocchi and passing on traditions for years, and in this episode she makes the gnocchi out of cheese.The comforting meal includes: Lentil Country Salad, Cheese Gnocchi with Butter and Sage Sauce, and Pork Pockets Stuffed with Pickles and Cheese.
programme.sub-title: Gnocchi Time Memories with the Grandkids

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. Here Lidia chooses three great dishes that can be made in very little time but offer great flavors and complexity. They are great as appetizers, sides or by themselves and include Caprese Salad with Celery and Walnuts, Stuffed Artichokes with Tuna and Scallop Salad
programme.sub-title: Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes are known in the Italian culture although the tradition goes way beyond the simple tomato sauce. Lidia gathers some of her favorite tomato based recipes and shares them in this episode including: Tomato and Mint Salad, Tomato and Ricotta Crostini, Spaghetti with Quick Pantry Sauce. She finishes with a Gluttonous Tomato- a perfect appetizer or lunch dish starring oven baked tomatoes stuffed with bread, grated cheese and seasoning and topped with farm eggs. Yum!
programme.sub-title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians don't like to eat big pieces of meat, but they do like to braise small pieces with lots of vegetables into delicious ragus. In this episode, Lidia creates a delicious meal of Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; mouthwatering Lamb Ragu prepared with an array of peppers and potatoes and for a sweet finish, a Gianduia Cake made of hazelnuts and chocolate- a Piedmontese tradition.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.sub-title: Anita Manning and Paul Laidlaw, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.sub-title: Anita Manning and Paul Laidlaw, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.sub-title: Anita Manning and Paul Laidlaw, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: A big fan of hats, there's little surprise when Anita Manning splurges on a deep-sea diver's helmet; Paul Laidlaw, however, can't believe his luck when he uncovers a 200-year-old porcelain sugar bowl priced at just ten pounds.
programme.sub-title: Anita Manning and Paul Laidlaw, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.sub-title: Raj Bisram and Margie Cooper, Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: On their antiques hunt, Raj Bisram pursues a Chinese theme with his purchases, while Margie Cooper finds some sunken treasure; however, two pairs of art nouveau door handles are the surprise lot of the Woking auction.
programme.sub-title: Raj Bisram and Margie Cooper, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Raj Bisram gambles big on an antique wondering if the bidders find this unusual item of furniture as attractive as he does; Margie Cooper buys a deed box, a toolbox and a hat box.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.sub-title: Raj Bisram and Margie Cooper, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Rookie Angus Ashworth and old-hand David Harper buy chimney pots, vintage cases and an old washtub.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 2

programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 3

programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Arusha "Roo" Irvine and Angus Ashworth continue to scour the shops of south Wales for all things antique.
programme.sub-title: Arusha Irvine and Angus Ashworth, Day 3

programme.title: An Easter Bloom

programme.title: Eres mi tipo
programme.desc: Vanessa, una escritora de cultura pop de la ciudad de Nueva York, consigue la entrevista de su vida con el reconocido escritor Martin Clayborne.

programme.title: Romance de televisión
programme.desc: La tensión aumenta cuando la presentadora de un programa de ventas televisivas y su rival compiten para obtener un ascenso.

programme.title: Betty's Bad Luck in Love
programme.desc: Maldita desde la infancia a fracasar en el romance, las relaciones de Betty siempre han terminado en desastre. Sin embargo, cuando conoce a Alex, se siente tentada a intentarlo una vez más.

programme.title: Dulce otoño
programme.desc: Una joven y un productor de jarabe de arce descubren el secreto detrás de su herencia de una tienda de dulces.

programme.title: Hanky Panky
programme.desc: Un hombre y su amiga, una servilleta inteligente, aprenden a amar mientras salvan al mundo de un oscuro mal en una cabaña en lo profundo de las montañas de Utah.

programme.title: Amor en tierra
programme.desc: Un molesto pero atractivo surfista altera por completo los planes veraniegos de su vecina, una madre de dos niños.

programme.title: No hay planeación para el amor
programme.desc: Una organizadora de bodas y un asesor financiero descubren que tienen muchas cosas en común a pesar de sus diferencias.

programme.title: Enamorándome de Vermont
programme.desc: Una autora de best-seller que tiene amnesia debido a un accidente de coche, encuentra refugio con el médico local de una pequeña ciudad idílica en Vermont.

programme.title: Siempre en San Valentín
programme.desc: Una bloguera con mala suerte piensa que ha cambiado la racha el Día de San Valentín cuando se encuentra con un veterinario muy guapo, pero ella descubre que él es el que ha estado dejando comentarios groseros sobre sus artículos.

programme.title: A Scottish Love Scheme
programme.desc: Lily viaja a Escocia con su madre y se reencuentra con Logan, un amigo de la familia de la infancia. Sin que Lily y Logan lo supieran, sus madres entrometidas traman un plan para hacer de casamenteras.

programme.title: Sellado con un beso. Boda: 6 de marzo
programme.desc: Los planes de boda aumentan para una celebridad y su prometida, y Mick tiene una tentadora oportunidad que Olivia no le permitirá rechazar.

programme.title: La novia de Navidad
programme.desc: Una organizadora de bodas debe viajar a Alaska para encontrar una flor exótica para un cliente. Allí, conoce un hombre que se ofrece a ayudarla.

programme.title: Carta de Navidad
programme.desc: Gretchen regresa a su ciudad natal por las fiestas y conoce a Melissa. Ambas forman una amistad, hasta que descubren una gran sorpresa.

programme.title: Jugando con el corazón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que pertenecen a distintas generaciones y tienen estilos de vida muy distintos, coinciden en un punto común: buscan el amor y la amistad en Los Ángeles de hoy en día.

programme.title: Un invierno en Vail
programme.desc: Una coordinadora de eventos de Los Ángeles se entera de que su distante tío ha fallecido recientemente y que le dejó una cabaña en Vail, Colorado.

programme.title: El velo de novia: La revelación
programme.desc: Emma viaja a Italia para investigar un velo de novia que se dice que trae amor a su dueña. Mientras está allí, conoce a Paolo, el hijo de una familia que hace encajes.

programme.title: Boda de Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Una mujer entrometida gana una boda con todos los gastos pagos en Beverly Hills para su hermana. Sin embargo, pronto descubre que su ex también está ayudando a planear la ceremonia.

programme.title: Ángel de Navidad
programme.desc: Susan tiene celebraciones Grinch por fiestas, desde que su novio la dejó en Navidad. Pero ella tiene la gran oportunidad de escribir una historia personal en una columna, escribiendo sobre un ángel de Navidad familiar tallado en madera.

programme.title: Un secreto de navidad
programme.desc: Una madre soltera en apuros busca una reliquia mágica, perteneciente a su familia, que espera le traiga amor, felicidad y fortuna durante la Navidad.

programme.title: Royally Ever After

programme.title: El ingrediente secreto
programme.desc: Una pastelera de un pequeño pueblo se reúne con su exprometido después de viajar a la ciudad de Nueva York para competir en un programa de cocina del Día de San Valentín.

programme.title: Beso de medianoche
programme.desc: Con solo una semana para prepararse, organizadores de fiestas logran realizar el mayor proyecto en la historia de su compañía: una fiesta de Año Nuevo para un famoso empresario de tecnología.

programme.title: Three Wise Men and a Baby
programme.desc: Tres hermanos experimentan viajes inesperados de autodescubrimiento y sanación cuando se ven obligados a trabajar juntos para cuidar a un bebé durante las fiestas.

programme.title: Navidad en Castle Hart
programme.desc: Brooke Bennett visita Irlanda durante la Navidad para conocer sus raíces irlandesas. Ella es confundida con una organizadora de eventos de alta categoría y la contratan para organizar una fiesta de Navidad grandiosa en el castillo de un noble.

programme.title: Amigos por correspondencia
programme.desc: Una organizadora de eventos está entusiasmada por planear la boda de su mejor amiga en París. Sin embargo, descubre que su ex llevará una cita y decide volver a hablar con un amigo francés por correspondencia que tenía en la infancia.

programme.title: Una pizca de amor
programme.desc: Cuando una aspirante a chef llega al trabajo de sus sueños en el restaurante de su ídolo, se hace amiga del guapo chef ejecutivo. Después de que ellos son despedidos equivocadamente, la pareja abre su propio restaurante para probar que su comida es mejor.

programme.title: Dos al rescate
programme.desc: Dos padres solteros compiten por el mismo perro en un evento de adopción de mascotas en la escuela.

programme.title: La tarjeta de Navidad
programme.desc: Nicky y su amiga se embarcan en la búsqueda de un admirador secreto que le escribió una tarjeta de Navidad tiempo atrás.

programme.title: Reenamorándonos
programme.desc: Atrapada en un matrimonio rutinario, una mujer se despierta mágicamente 15 años antes y decide si volverá a elegir al mismo hombre.

programme.title: The Good Witch's Destiny
programme.desc: All Good Witch Cassie wants for her birthday is for her family and friends to be together, but new family member Gwen's estranged son makes trouble for Cassie while her own stepson seems determined to take a step neither Cassie nor her husband think he is ready for. Meanwhile, stepdaughter Lori discovers disturbing parallels between Cassie and the original Grey Lady who disappeared at her own birthday party years before.

programme.title: Sandra Brown's White Hot
programme.desc: When her younger brother dies, Sayre breaks a vow and returns to her home in Louisiana. She gets drawn back into the web of her father, and when the police determine that her brother was murdered, Sayre must battle her family to get justice.

programme.title: Truly, Madly, Sweetly
programme.desc: Natalie and Eric must learn to work together after they both inherit an old, historic bakery. Natalie soon realizes that she has a chance to have it all, a business to call her own, and the true love of her life.

As soon as she arrives, Dana starts butting heads with her cabin neighbor, Steve, a single father and outdoorsman who is also in search of a connection with his teen daughter. As the ice melts between Dana and Steve, they're able to find that missing piece in one another that helps them draw closer to their respective children.

Now their children, and co-workers, Casey and Sam, are set to carry on the rivalry as they go head-to-head in the same contest. There's only problem for these two people who are supposed to hate each other, they start to fall in love. Stars Julie Gonzalo and Eric Aragon.

The couple focus all their attention and love on their son, Simon (Jordan Brower), and daughter, Clea (Thora Birch). When Simon dies suddenly in a tragic horseback-riding accident, Nora takes the death especially hard and falls into a deep depression. With the help of Nora's mother, Maggie (Ellen Burstyn), Neal attempts to reconnect with his wife and save his family.

programme.title: Crossroads: A Story of Forgiveness

Larry's family is uncomfortable at first around Lara, whom Gladwyn treats differently from her biological offspring. Easing the transition along is Thunderwith, a dog who becomes a friend to Lara, helping her forgive and connect to the relative strangers who make up her new family.
